summary: As expected, Ben Samek has been named CEO of Banijay America, the combined structure created following Banijay Entertainment’s recent merger with All3Media. Samek will report to Banijay Entertainment deputy chief executive officer Jane Turton. Meanwhile, Banijay Entertainment has also launched Banijay Latin America, for production businesses and activities in the region.
bullet_points: As expected, Ben Samek has been named CEO of Banijay America, the combined structure created following Banijay Entertainment’s recent merger with All3Media.
Samek will report to Banijay Entertainment deputy chief executive officer Jane Turton.
Meanwhile, Banijay Entertainment has also launched Banijay Latin America, for production businesses and activities in the region.
